I need a tagline and positioning statement for [your business/product]. Here's the context:
- What I do: [describe your offering]
- Who I serve: [target customer]
- What makes me different: [your key differentiator]
- The result I deliver: [the transformation or outcome]
- Brand personality: [e.g., bold, trustworthy, irreverent, premium, approachable]
Give me: (1) 10 tagline options (under 8 words each) — range from clever to straightforward, (2) A one-sentence positioning statement using the format: "For [audience] who [situation], [your brand] is the [category] that [key benefit] unlike [alternative] which [limitation]," (3) A 30-second elevator pitch I can say out loud.
